t1.descripcion:
Verbs are words that express actions, states or processes.

🔹 EXAMPLES OF VERBS IN SPANISH:
• comer = to eat
• beber = to drink
• vivir = to live
• hablar = to speak
• estudiar = to study
• trabajar = to work
• correr = to run
• dormir = to sleep

🔹 PARTS OF THE VERB (parts of the verb):
Every verb in Spanish has:

1. RAÍZ (root) = the part that does not change (or changes little)
2. TERMINACIÓN (ending) = the part that changes according to the person

Example with HABLAR:
• Raíz: HABL-
• Terminación: -AR

🔹 THE THREE TYPES OF VERBS IN SPANISH:
• Verbs ending in -AR (hablar, cantar, bailar)
• Verbs ending in -ER (comer, beber, correr)
• Verbs ending in -IR (vivir, escribir, partir)

📌 IMPORTANT:
In Spanish, verbs change their ending according to the person who performs the action (yo, tú, él, etc.). This is called CONJUGACIÓN.
ejemplos: Los verbos en -AR son los más comunes.

t2.descripcion:
In Spanish there are six grammatical persons:

🔹 SINGULAR:
1. YO = I
2. TÚ = you (informal, singular)
3. ÉL / ELLA / USTED = he / she / you (formal, singular)

🔹 PLURAL:
4. NOSOTROS / NOSOTRAS = we (masculine/feminine)
5. VOSOTROS / VOSOTRAS = you all (informal, plural - Spain only)
6. ELLOS / ELLAS / USTEDES = they (masculine/feminine) / you all (formal - Latin America)

🔹 LOS PRONOMBRES SUJETO (subject pronouns):
• yo = I
• tú = you (informal)
• él = he
• ella = she
• usted = you (formal)
• nosotros / nosotras = we
• vosotros / vosotras = you all (Spain)
• ellos / ellas = they
• ustedes = you all (formal / Latin America)

📌 IMPORTANT NOTE:
In Spanish, it is not always necessary to use the subject pronoun because the verb conjugation already indicates the person.
Example: "Hablo español" (yo) is enough, there is no need to say "Yo hablo español".

❌ COMMON MISTAKE:
Using the subject pronoun all the time sounds unnatural. Native speakers omit it unless they want to emphasize.

t3.titulo: The conjugation of regular verbs in the present tense
t3.descripcion:
To conjugate a regular verb in the present tense:

1. Remove the ending -AR, -ER or -IR
2. Add the corresponding ending

🔹 VERBS IN -AR (example: HABLAR = to speak):

• yo habl- **O**
• tú habl- **AS**
• él/ella/usted habl- **A**
• nosotros habl- **AMOS**
• vosotros habl- **ÁIS**
• ellos/ellas/ustedes habl- **AN**

🔹 VERBS IN -ER (example: COMER = to eat):

• yo com- **O**
• tú com- **ES**
• él/ella/usted com- **E**
• nosotros com- **EMOS**
• vosotros com- **ÉIS**
• ellos/ellas/ustedes com- **EN**

🔹 VERBS IN -IR (example: VIVIR = to live):

• yo viv- **O**
• tú viv- **ES**
• él/ella/usted viv- **E**
• nosotros viv- **IMOS**
• vosotros viv- **ÍS**
• ellos/ellas/ustedes viv- **EN**

📌 SUMMARY TABLE OF ENDINGS:

| Person | -AR | -ER | -IR |
|---------|-----|-----|-----|
| yo | -o | -o | -o |
| tú | -as | -es | -es |
| él/ella/usted | -a | -e | -e |
| nosotros | -amos | -emos | -imos |
| vosotros | -áis | -éis | -ís |
| ellos/ellas/ustedes | -an | -en | -en |

📌 EXAMPLES:
• Yo hablo español.
• Tú comes paella.
• Ella vive en Madrid.

t4.titulo: Important verbs: Ser, Estar, Tener, Haber
t4.descripcion:
🔹 SER (to be - essential/permanent):
• yo SOY
• tú ERES
• él/ella/usted ES
• nosotros SOMOS
• vosotros SOIS
• ellos/ellas/ustedes SON

Uses: identity, origin, profession, characteristics, time, date, material.

🔹 ESTAR (to be - state/temporary):
• yo ESTOY
• tú ESTÁS
• él/ella/usted ESTÁ
• nosotros ESTAMOS
• vosotros ESTÁIS
• ellos/ellas/ustedes ESTÁN

Uses: location, emotions, temporary states, actions in progress.

🔹 TENER (to have):
• yo TENGO
• tú TIENES
• él/ella/usted TIENE
• nosotros TENEMOS
• vosotros TENÉIS
• ellos/ellas/ustedes TIENEN

Uses: possession, age, expressions (hambre, sed, sueño, calor, frío, prisa).

🔹 HABER (to have - auxiliary):
• yo HE
• tú HAS
• él/ella/usted HA
• nosotros HEMOS
• vosotros HABÉIS
• ellos/ellas/ustedes HAN

Uses: compound tenses (pretérito perfecto), impersonal existence (hay).

📌 COMPARATIVE EXAMPLES:
• Soy médico (profession - SER)
• Estoy en el hospital (location - ESTAR)
• Tengo hambre (expression - TENER)
• He comido (pretérito perfecto - HABER)

dict.大卫，西班牙语里'tengo hambre'是什么意思？: David, what does 'tengo hambre' mean in Spanish?
dict.意思是'我饿了'。这是用动词'tener'的一个表达。: It means 'I am hungry'. It's an expression with the verb 'tener'.
dict.渴、困、热、冷、赶时间、小心: thirsty, sleepy, hot, cold, in a hurry, careful
dict.那么，'tener'不仅仅表示拥有。: So 'tener' doesn't just mean to have.
dict.没错。这是一个非常重要的动词。: That's right. It's a very important verb.
dict.用作助动词构成复合时态。: It's used as an auxiliary verb to form compound tenses.
dict.没错。它也用于无人称形式：'hay'（有）。: Exactly. It's also used in impersonal form: 'hay' (there is).
dict.那么，'hay un libro'意思是'有一本书'。: So 'hay un libro' means 'there is a book'.

dict.我叫李，是西班牙语学生。每天我七点起床。我先吃早饭，然后去大学。在课堂上我和同学: My name is Li, and I am a Spanish student. Every day I get up at seven. I have breakfast first, then I go to university. In class, I speak Spanish with my classmates. My friend Wang eats in the cafeteria, but I eat at home. In the afternoon, we study in the library. They live in a small apartment. My teacher has two children. She is very friendly. Where are you? I am at home. Do you have siblings? No, I don't have siblings. Are there many students in your class? Yes, there are twenty students. We are friends.
dict.李几点起床？: What time does Li get up?
dict.文中说“me levanto a las siete”（我七点起床）。: The text says “me levanto a las siete” (I get up at seven).
dict.文中说“Mi amigo Wang come en la cafetería”（: The text says “Mi amigo Wang come en la cafetería” (My friend Wang eats in the cafeteria).
dict.李有几个兄弟姐妹？: How many siblings does Li have?
dict.文中说“No, no tengo hermanos”（不，我没有兄弟姐妹）。: The text says “No, no tengo hermanos” (No, I don't have siblings).
dict.他们下午在哪里学习？: Where do they study in the afternoon?
dict.文中说“nosotros estudiamos en la biblioteca: The text says “nosotros estudiamos en la biblioteca” (we study in the library).
dict.在西班牙，很多人下午两点或三点吃午饭，晚上九点或十点吃晚饭。小商店下午关门，晚上: In Spain, many people have lunch at two or three in the afternoon and dinner at nine or ten at night. Small shops close in the afternoon and reopen in the evening. Students usually have classes in the morning and afternoon. It is typical to have a coffee or a snack in the middle of the morning. On weekends, people go out with friends and come home late.
dict.在中国，人们通常中午十二点左右吃午饭，晚上六七点吃晚饭，比西班牙早很多。: In China, people usually have lunch around twelve noon and dinner at six or seven in the evening, much earlier than in Spain.
dict.这句话是正确的，但注意：ser用于身份，estar用于状态。中国学生常混淆ser: This sentence is correct, but note: ser is used for identity, estar for state. Chinese students often confuse ser and estar.
dict.这句话是正确的，但中国学生常误用“soy 20 años”或“estoy 20: This sentence is correct, but Chinese students often misuse “soy 20 años” or “estoy 20 años”. Age is expressed with tener.
dict.这句话是正确的，但注意动词变位要与主语一致。中国学生有时忘记变位，如“nosot: This sentence is correct, but note that the verb conjugation must agree with the subject. Chinese students sometimes forget to conjugate, e.g., “nosotros estudia”.
dict.表示位置时用estar，不用ser。中国学生常混淆。: Use estar, not ser, to express location. Chinese students often confuse them.
dict.这句话是正确的，但注意hay是haber的无人称形式，表示“有”。中国学生有时误: This sentence is correct, but note that hay is the impersonal form of haber, meaning “there is/are”. Chinese students sometimes misuse “tiene” to express existence.
dict.汉语中没有颤音r，练习时舌尖轻抵上齿龈，让气流使舌尖振动。可以先练习“pero”: There is no trilled r in Chinese. When practicing, lightly touch the tip of your tongue to the alveolar ridge and let the airflow make it vibrate. You can first practice the difference between “pero” (but) and “perro” (dog).
